label: Demand
definition: The amount of some good or service consumers are willing and able to purchase at each price; in economic terminology, the relationship between a range of prices and the quantities demanded at those prices.

scope.text: Introductory economics; markets for goods and services

notes: Source explicitly distinguishes demand (the curve/relationship) from quantity demanded (a point on the curve). Definition is embedded here as a deliberate pilot variation; review whether it should be a separate definitional Statement.
